data.name: Aiesha
data.gender_notes: Aiesha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who lives, or is living, in submission to Allah. The name Aiesha carries the meaning “Living One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aiesha usually hope their child will grow to embody living one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the importance of living a life devoted to Allah.
data.etymology: Aiesha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Living One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aiesha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عائشة
in_arabic.meaning: تعني عائشة حياة سعيدة وصحية ومليئة بالخير
in_arabic.long_meaning: عائشة اسم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ي-ش' والذي يعني الحياة السعيدة والصحية والمليئة بالخير. ورد ذكر اسم عائشة في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، الآية ١٢٥، حيث ذكرت زوجة النبي إبراهيم عليه السلام. وعائشة هي اسم زوجة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهي من أكثر النساء تأثيرًا في التاريخ الإسلامي. يتميز اسم عائشة بالمعاني الإيجابية مثل الحياة السعيدة والخير الكثير

in_urdu.name: عائشہ
in_urdu.meaning: عائشہ کا مطلب ہے خوشحال زندگی گزارنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عائشہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ع-ي-ش' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشحال زندگی گزارنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تاریخ میں اہم کردار رکھنے والی حضرت عائشہ بنت ابو بکر صدیق رضی اللہ عنہا کے نام سے منسلک ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے۔ عائشہ کے معنی ہیں وہ زندگی جو سکھ، صحت اور خوشحالی سے بھری ہو

in_hindi.name: आइशा
in_hindi.meaning: आइशा का अर्थ है सुखी और समृद्ध जीवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: आइशा एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ع-ي-ش' जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है सुखी और समृद्ध जीवन। यह नाम इस्लामी इतिहास में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाने वाली हज़रत आयशा बिन्त अबू बक्र सिद्दीق रज़ी अल्लाहु अन्हा के नाम से जुड़ा है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है। आइशा के अर्थ हैं वह जीवन जो सुख, स्वास्थ्य और समृद्धि से भरा हो

in_pashto.name: عائشې
in_pashto.meaning: عائشې د خوشحالۍ او سوکاله ژوند معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عائشې د عربي نوم دی چې د 'ع-ي-ش' ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د خوشحالۍ او سوکاله ژوند معنی لري. دا نوم د اسلامي تاريخ په اوږدو کې د پام وړ رول لوبولو د حضرت عائشې بنت ابوبکر صدیق رضی الله عنها په نامه تړلی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې ډیر مشهور دی. عائشې د هغې ژوند معنی لري چې په خوشحالي، روغتيا او سوکالۍ کې ډک دی

in_english.name: Aiesha
in_english.meaning: Aiesha means living a happy and healthy life
in_english.long_meaning: Aiesha is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ع-ي-ش' (A-y-sh), which signifies a happy and healthy life. The name Aiesha is associated with Aisha bint Abi Bakr, one of the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and a prominent figure in Islamic history. Aiesha symbolizes a life filled with joy, prosperity, and well-being. It is widely used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting positive attributes such as happiness and health

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Aisha is of Arabic origin and holds a significant place in Islamic history. Aisha bint Abu Bakr (radiyallahu anha) was a prominent wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for her intelligence, knowledge, courage, and strong faith. She served as a role model for Muslim women and played a crucial role in the early Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Aisha signifies living a life in submission to Allah. It is a reminder that every aspect of our lives should be dedicated to Allah and His pleasure. It also embodies the qualities of intelligence, knowledge, and strength that are essential for spiritual growth and progress. Therefore, bearing the name 'Aisha is a constant reminder to stay connected to Allah and strive for His pleasure in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Living One" symbolizes The one who lives, or is living, in submission to Allah.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aiesha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of living one.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Aisha bint Abu Bakr (614-678 CE) was a prominent wife of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and one of the most beloved figures in Islamic history.
historical_references.context: Aisha was a significant figure in early Islamic history as one of Muhammad's wives and a key player in the political and social life of the early Muslim community.

trends: Aisha is a popular name for girls in the Muslim world and beyond.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aiesha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
